# Upscaled

> London web design studio building custom websites for UK small businesses. Fixed price, live in about two weeks.

## Who we are
Upscaled is a new web design and development studio based in London, working with businesses across the UK.

## What we build
Custom websites designed from scratch (no templates), built mobile-first. Every website project includes copywriting help, Google Business Profile set-up, basic SEO, analytics, domain and email set-up, and 30 days of free fixes after launch. You own your site and domain.

## Who it's for
UK small businesses that need a new website or want to improve an existing one.

## How it works
1. Call: we talk about your business, your customers and what the site needs to do.
2. Design: we design your homepage first and refine it with you.
3. Build: we build the other pages, add your content and test on phones and desktops.
4. Launch: we connect your domain, set up Google and analytics, and check it all works.

A one-page site is usually live in about 1 week, and a site with several pages in about 2 weeks. Timing depends on how quickly we receive your content.

## Quotes and payment
Each project gets a fixed written quote within 48 hours of your call. Payment is in two stages: a 50% deposit, then the balance at launch.

## Optional add-ons
- Missed-call text-back
- AI enquiry replies
- Online booking and reminders
- Review requests
- Ongoing care plan (hosting, updates, small edits)

## Free website audit
Send us your site and we'll send back 5 specific fixes within 2 working days. Free, no obligation.
